content.html:
Life is easy when you have an instant pot cooker at your disposal, but it is not enough to make these amazing dishes and do away with leftovers. When preparing several recipes in your Instant Pot, it's nice having a big enough container to store your leftovers. With a handy silicone cover, you can easily remove the inner lining of the Instant Pot and place it in the refrigerator. To top it off, it is less stressful and easily managed.

If you've doubted anything about instant pot fridge storage reheating, then search no further. This article has got you covered.

The inner lining of the instant pot enables you to preserve your meals. It is equipped with a silicone lid that fits firmly and seals food to ensure that your meals remain fresh in the refrigerator. 

LATEST VIDEOS

In this write-up, we provide answers to all your questions regarding this subject and some amazing reheating tips to help you enjoy the process better. So you don't want to stop reading here! 

Can I put my instant pot inner pot in the fridge?

Unlike other methods of preserving leftover food, the IP has an inner pot, so you don't need to Ziploc to preserve your food. Sometimes, you may be afraid of losing the delicious taste and freshness of your leftovers. Using the inner pot and lid combo mitigates off-tasting food. Your meals are kept fresh, and their flavor is retained throughout the night.

It is safe to put your IP inner pot in the fridge because its airtight lid prevents it from being contaminated. This aspect of its design reduces the risk of any health issues. On the other hand, you may be wondering whether or not the IP inner pot can retain food for a long period?

Just like any other preservation method, there are limits. Keeping food for a long period under preservation is not healthy, no matter how effective this preservation method is. For this reason, it is better not to keep food for more than 24 hours in the IP inner pot just to be on the safe and healthier path.

Is it wise to put the cold (from the fridge) inner pot in the instant pot? 

It is preliminary that you allow your instant pot to pressurize before getting on with your recipe. This is a way of getting your instant pot ready for cooking! What happens when you put a cold inner pot in the instant pot?

Putting a cold inner pot in the instant pot causes a drop in the temperature of the instant pot. For this reason, your instant pot will require more time to attain the desired temperature and pressure.

Therefore, moving your inner pot from the fridge to the instant pot for cooking is perfectly alright as long as you can wait an additional 10-20 mins for your instant pot to get pressurized.

Looking from another direction, it is time-saving because you can prepare your ingredients the night before, preserve them in the fridge, and commerce your cooking.

Can you put the inner pot inside the oven to reheat food?

The inner pot was designed exclusively for use with the Instant Pot cooker base and may not be suitable for oven use. However, Some inner pots are stainless steel, while others have a ceramic non-stick interior coating. As a result, they can function as oven pans since they support a temperature of 360C / 680f.

Can I reheat food in just the inner pot on a stovetop?

The inner pot was designed exclusively for use with the Instant Pot cooker base and is not suitable for stovetops. However, many people, as well as myself, use just the inner pot for reheating on the stovetop.

If the inner pot gets twisted or broken, it may no longer be able to make a good connection with the heating element within the cooker base and hence will not properly cook your food. According to the one-year guarantee, manufacturers do not advocate putting the Instant Pot on the stovetop or setting it near any other heat source.

You usually don't need to if you're just searing meat or sautéing vegetables. Those tasks are easily accomplished by utilizing the inner pot contained within the Instant Pot housing. 

However, for the finest and hottest browning of meats, select the "More" adjustment setting for the Saute mode, heat well before adding oil/meat, do not crowd the meat in pieces, and leave the meat alone as it browns on each side.

If you require a more intense sear, use a different skillet for that stage or work in batches if necessary.

If you need a "big pot that can also be used on a stovetop" for any reason, you could use the inner pot, although the bottom will likely discolor (the stainless steel ones will not warp). Or use a separate aluminum stockpot.

Can my inner pot work on an induction stove?

For an induction stove, the coils of the magnet have to adhere to the bottom of the inner pan. There are different types of stainless steel, but only that which is magnetic and ferrous can be used on an induction stove.

In the case of the inner pot, it is tri-ply stainless steel. It consists of three layers, the external layers being non-ferrous and non-magnetic, while the inner layer is ferrous and magnetic. For this reason, most inner pots will not serve a purpose on an induction stove.

Reheating tips

Below are some amazing reheating tips to help you through the process.

  •  Left-overs are most likely to taste better when reheated in the same way they were prepared. You wouldn't want to lose the taste of a delicious meal! Go ahead and conveniently use your inner pot.
  • In heating food in an oven, it is important to consider the type and quantity of leftover meals reheating time will depend on these two factors. 90-120C or 200-250f is the preferred temperature when heating stir-fried or steamed food.
  • It's crucial to note that the inner pot was specifically designed to fit in the instant pot. The cooking stove has a relatively higher temperature, and the heat is concentrated. Using the inner pot on the stove may rupture the bottom of the inner post and make it difficult to reuse. This is so because the inner pot is not a good thermal conductor, and as such, the pot's base may get blocked.

Conclusion

To conclude, the Instant Pot can be used for reheating, and it saves time. Instead of microwaving food or using the stove, you can spend very little time reheating the food. Also, this cuts down your feeding expenses because all the left-overs which would have been dumped will be consumed.

Furthermore, the IP fridge saves you the stress of getting separate bowls or packaging to preserve food. Since it is sold fully equipped, you won't need to transfer your leftover meals before preserving them. Among these amazing benefits, what's best about the IP fridge is that it has no side effects on your diet. All the nutritious values you are supposed to get from your meals will be retained. So you want to get your Instant Pot Fridge now and save more money! 

Thanks for reading to the end. We hope you learned!
